lead: Dev Anand was an Indian film actor, born on 26 September 1923 in Shakargarh Tehsil.
He died on 3 December 2011 in London at the age of 88.
He has 60 credited works on public record and has been recognised with Padma Bhushan and Dadasaheb Phalke Award.
The sections that follow break down Dev Anand's biography into quick facts, early life, career history, personal life and a year-by-year timeline.
